questions.explanation_pidgin: 64 na 4^3. Equate the power dem: 2x - 1 = 3 => 2x = 4 => x = 2.

questions.question: Find the gradient of the curve y = 2x^3 - 4x + 1 at the point where x = 2.
questions.explanation: First find dy/dx = 6x^2 - 4. At x = 2, dy/dx = 6(2)^2 - 4 = 24 - 4 = 20.
questions.explanation_pidgin: Differentiate am first: dy/dx = 6x^2 - 4. Put x = 2 inside: 6(4) - 4 = 20.
